children: U.S. avocado supplier's fiscal Q3 revenue grew 26% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS and adjusted net income for fiscal Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company raised annualized Calavo synergy outlook to more than $30 mln
Company expects Q4 avocado industry volumes to rise about 10% versus prior year
Pricing in Q4 expected to be about 10% lower than prior year due to higher supply
Mission Produce reaffirms H2 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook of $84 mln to $88 mln
AVOCADO VOLUME GROWTH - Revenue increase was driven by a 38% rise in avocado volumes, mainly from Calavo integration and higher Mexican supply
LOWER AVOCADO PRICES - Higher global supply led to a 9% decrease in per-unit avocado sales prices, partially offsetting volume gains
TARIFF REFUNDS - Blueberries segment operating income benefited from one-time IEEPA tariff refunds
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the fishing & farming peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Mission Produce Inc is $16.50, about 30.1% above its September 4 closing price of $12.68
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 17 three months ago
